subject: Garland
text: Garland has approximately 80 to 100 HP and can be countered by casting RUSE, FOG, and CURE to mitigate his damage.

evidence.quote:
BOSS FIGHT-Garland
HP: 80-100 or something like that
    This guy shouldn't be too hard.  He can to some heavy damage to some of your 
ill-equipped mages, but you can just cast RUSE, FOG, and CURE to help that.

subject: World Map
text: Pressing B and Select on the overworld opens the world map, as clued by reading the broom's backwards message 'HSUP B TCELES' in Matoya's Cave.

evidence.quote:
A broom there will say HSUP B 
TCELES.  Read it backward to see the message "Push B Select"  Do this in the 
outer world to see a world map.

subject: Matoya's Cave
text: Walking over the skulls in Matoya's Cave reveals 2 Heals and a Pure Potion.

evidence.quote:
Walk over the Skulls and pick up 2 Heals and a 
Pure Potion.

subject: Pirate
text: The 9 Pirates have 6 HP each and can be crippled by casting SLOW so they frequently miss or inflict only 1 damage.

evidence.quote:
BOSS FIGHT-Pirate x9
HP: 6 
     Any one of these guys is easy, but together, they can reek havoc on a wimpy 
little mage.  Before you come in, buy SLOW if you have a Red or Black Mage.  One 
shot of SLOW will send every pirate into vast stupidity, and you will notice 
that most of them either miss or do only one damage.

subject: Ship
text: Talking to the pirate after defeating his crew grants the ship.

evidence.quote: First, talk to the pirate to get his ship.

subject: Peninsula of Power
text: The top 2x2 squares of the peninsula northeast of Provoka contain extremely powerful high-level enemies.

evidence.quote:
Make your way Northeast until you come to a Peninsula.  The top 2x2 squares 
contain REALLY powerful enemies, and they will probably knock you out for your 
first couple tries.

subject: ZomBULL and TROLL
text: ZomBULLs and Trolls on the Peninsula of Power are weak against fire and can be dispatched using FIR2.

evidence.quote:
You can also encounter ZomBULLs and TROLLS.  These 
guys are tough, but they're weak against fire, so protect your weak characters, 
have your fighters fight, and cast FIR2 to the bitter end.

subject: Frost Wolves
text: Frost Wolves cast FROST to deal heavy group damage, but can all be eliminated with 1 to 2 castings of FIR2.

evidence.quote:
Another possibility is a pack of Frost Wolves (varying numbers).  
They have very little attack damage (relatively speaking).  They will use FROST 
on you, which will cause a lot of damage to everyone.  If this kills you, reset.  
Otherwise, just 1-2 FIR2 spells will knock them all out, regardless of their 
numbers.

subject: Tyro
text: Tyro can inflict 90 to 100 damage against a fully armored fighter, requiring support spells like TMPR, RUSE, INVS, and FOG.

evidence.quote:
You can also encounter a Tyro.  Beware, he can easily do 90-100 damage 
points even to a fully armored fighter.  Use defensive tactics on him, as FIR2 
won't be much help.  Use TMPR, RUSE, INVS, and FOG for support.

subject: Sleeping Prince
text: The sleeping Prince in Elfland Castle requires HERB to be awakened.

evidence.quote:
You can 
talk to the people in the castle to learn that the Prince is sleeping and he 
needs HERB to wake him up.

subject: Elfland
text: Elfland shop equipment costs 4000 GP for a Silver Sword, 800 GP for Iron Armor, 100 GP for an Iron Shield, 100 GP for a Wood Helm, and 60 GP for Gloves.

evidence.quote:
Fighter: 4000(silver sword)+800(iron armor)+100(iron shield)+100(wood 
helm)+60(gloves)= 5060 GP

subject: Elfland
text: Level 3 spells cost 1500 GP each (4500 GP for 3 spells), while Level 4 spells cost 12000 GP in Elfland.

subject: Zeus Gauntlet
text: The Zeus Gauntlet casts LIT2 when used in battle.

evidence.quote:
casting LIT2 will be obsolete with the Zeus Gauntlet (casts 
LIT2 when USED in battle)

subject: Elfland
text: Supplies for the Marsh Cave cost 4825 GP total: 50 HEAL potions for 3000 GP, 20 PURE potions for 1500 GP, a CABIN for 250 GP, and a TENT for 75 GP.

evidence.quote:
At the very LEAST, you will need 
50 HEAL potions [3000 GP], 20 PURE potions [1500], a CABIN [250], and a TENT 
[75] = 4825 GP.

subject: Muck
text: Muck enemies take only 1 damage from regular attacks and should be countered using FIRE or FIR2.

evidence.quote:
If you encounter a Muck 
and can't run, use FIRE or FIR2 on them, as any regular attack will only do 1 
damage.

subject: CROWN
text: The CROWN is found in the treasure chest located in the throne room on the 3rd row down and 2nd column from the left on the grid floor of the Marsh Cave.

evidence.quote:
Most of the other rooms have some good treasure.  Get it 
or don't, but your real destination is the 3rd row down, and the 2nd column from 
the left.  Here, there will be some odd structure that looks like a throne, with 
a treasure chest in the middle...retrieve the CROWN from the treasure chest, and exit 
the cave.

subject: Wizards
text: Wizards appear in groups of 2 to 5, can deal 120 damage to mages or 50 damage to fighters, and can be defeated using roughly 2 castings of LIT2.

evidence.quote:
[semi] BOSS FIGHT-WIZARDS
     Well, these guys aren't exactly bosses, but they'll give you as much hassle 
as one.  They come in packs of 2-5.  They don't have many HP, but their attacks 
are VERY powerful.  A lightly armored White or Black Mage can take as much as 
120 damage from one Wizard.  Although they usually don't do that much, even a 
Fighter can easily take as much as 50 damage...Have 
Black and Red Mages use LIT2.  About 2 shots of LIT2 will be enough to take out 
all the Wizards.

subject: Wizard
text: Each Wizard defeated yields 400 GP and considerable EXP, making 3 to 4 battles sufficient to afford a Silver Sword or a Level 4 spell.

evidence.quote:
Each 
Wizard gives you 400 GP and a considerable amount of EXP, so just 3-4 battles 
will be enough to buy a Silver Sword or a L4 Magic spell.

subject: Tent
text: A tent can be used on the way to get 30 HP and a save.

evidence.quote: Use the tent on the way if you need to get 30 HP and a save.
